reference: Full research bounds, not measured hardware tolerances. Each group scale multiplies its radius once. Timing uses explicit discrete ranges independently.
notes: The initial selected study tests noise and encoder bias, without simultaneously changing dynamics, moving IMU mount, ground or timing.
All training remains fresh actor, fresh critic, empty Adam. No checkpoint resume, donor or teacher.
Motor/encoder velocity white noise is policy-rate observation noise; this does not claim 1kHz PD white-noise coverage.
Legacy policy-encoder and PD encoder biases are independently drawn. Their disagreement is reported, not hidden or claimed hardware-identified.
The nominal fraction applies to the shared rigid-body/actuator/sensor mask. When friction varies it applies to every ground lane, so that fraction is not a fully nominal-scene guarantee.
Native timing is retained initially. Delay experiments must explicitly edit the discrete timing ranges and use a new frozen profile/receipt.
A strength argument scales the named profile's group radii. It does not silently change timing or the randomized population fraction.
